material_definitions:
Compounds of LiGa(1-x)Al(x)GeO4 with 0 
le x 
le 1 were synthesized and examined.
The x=0 and 0.25 samples were found to exhibit a phenacite structure with R3 space group.
The x>=0.5 samples were found to exhibit an ordered phenacite structure with R3 space group due to the 1:1 cation order between Ga3+/Al3+ and Ge4+ ions.

The LGAGO and related compounds are usually prepared below 1000
celsius.

The study investigates the LiGa1-xAlxGeO4 (LGAGO) solid solution series with 0 "


  "<=" x "<=" 1. The samples show decreased secondary particle size and bulk density with increasing x. The x=0 sample possesses the phenacite structure (R


  "<=" 3 space group) along with minor impurities (LiGa5O8 and Li2GeO3). For x ">=" 0.5, the materials adopt an ordered phenacite structure (R3 space group), exhibiting cation order between Ga3+/Al3+ and Ge4+ ions. Electrical conductivity was measured using EIS across a range of temperatures.
